backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing board creation, metadata with backgrounds, operations list management, and background update/query APIs.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old board states to the new format by adding default metadata to each board.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping background-related features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of all frontend files, including background handling and canvas rendering.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme variables defining color tokens for light/dark modes and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining root container and loading the main React script.
frontend/README.md: Project README detailing features, setup steps, development workflow, and keyboard shortcuts for the whiteboard app.
frontend/src/api/boardApi.ts: Thin wrapper exposing backend canister calls including createBoard, snapshot, operations, and background updates.
frontend/src/api/index.ts: Barrel export re-exporting boardApi, boardSnapshot, polling sync, and opCodec utilities.
frontend/src/api/opCodec.ts: Converts backend operations into whiteboard elements, mapping draw, shape, and text ops to local element formats.
frontend/src/api/useBoardPollingSync.ts: Polls the backend for new board operations and background changes, applying updates and tracking version state.
frontend/src/api/useBoardSnapshot.ts: Fetches or creates a board snapshot, applies initial operations, and initializes background mode.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing navigation between home and board views and forwarding initial background/title parameters.
frontend/src/canvas/hitTest.ts: Provides hit-testing utilities for strokes, shapes, and text elements to determine if a point intersects them.
frontend/src/canvas/render.ts: Renders the canvas background and all whiteboard elements according to the viewport and background mode.
frontend/src/canvas/types.ts: Defines type interfaces for points, viewport, colors, and all whiteboard element structures.
frontend/src/canvas/viewport.ts: Implements coordinate conversions between screen and world space and clamps zoom levels.
Displays authentication controls, showing login, loading, or account menu based on user identity state.
frontend/src/components/board/BoardTopBa: Renders the board's top toolbar with title editing, exports, background selection, and navigation actions.
frontend/src/components/board/CreateBoar: A dialog for creating new boards, allowing name entry and background template selection.
frontend/src/components/board/Participan: Displays unique board participants derived from operation authors and shows them in a scrollable card.
frontend/src/components/board/ShareDialo: Modal that shows a board ID and shareable URL with copy‑to‑clipboard support.
frontend/src/components/branding/LogoMar: Renders the project’s logo image at a configurable size.
frontend/src/components/index.ts: Re-exports all major component modules for simplified imports.
frontend/src/components/whiteboard/Inspe: Shows properties of the selected whiteboard element or a placeholder when none or multiple are selected.
frontend/src/components/whiteboard/Keybo: Hook that binds keyboard shortcuts for tool switching, undo/redo, and deleting elements.
frontend/src/components/whiteboard/ToolB: Vertical toolbar offering tool selection, undo/redo, and zoom controls with icons and tooltips.
frontend/src/components/whiteboard/White: Interactive canvas that renders elements, handles pointer interactions, and manages zoom and viewport updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity data and login state. Provides hooks and helper functions to create AuthClient and handle login, logout, and stored identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining color themes, typography, whiteboard UI styles, and custom scrollbars. Includes light/dark mode variables and whiteboard-specific layout classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app using ReactDOM, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider. Imports global styles and mounts the App component.
frontend/src/pages/BoardPage.tsx: Renders the collaborative board UI, loading board data, syncing via polling, and managing title and recent board storage. Displays canvas, toolbar, panels, and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home screen allowing users to create or join boards, view recent boards, and authenticate. Handles board navigation and creation via dialogs and input forms.
frontend/src/pages/index.ts: Re-exports HomePage and BoardPage components for cleaner imports.
frontend/src/state/applyRemoteOps.ts: Applies remote operations to the board by converting ops to elements and adding non-duplicate elements to the store.
frontend/src/state/boardStore.ts: Zustand store managing whiteboard state including elements, selection, tools, viewport, history, and background. Provides actions for CRUD operations, undo/redo, and board configuration.
frontend/src/state/history.ts: Defines a simple history state structure and factory for undo/redo functionality.
frontend/src/state/identity.ts: Provides helpers to format principal identities into display names and initials.
frontend/src/state/index.ts: Aggregates exports for board store, history utilities, recent board helpers, and identity helpers.
frontend/src/state/recentBoards.ts: Manages recent boards in localStorage, supporting adding, opening, listing, and removing up to a max count.
frontend/src/tools/toolHandler.ts: Implements pointer handlers for drawing tools, shape creation, and selection, updating the board store with new elements.
frontend/src/tools/toolTypes.ts: Defines whiteboard tool types and a ToolSettings interface for stroke and fill colors and size.
frontend/src/utils/exporters.ts: Provides PNG export via canvas.toBlob and JSON export by copying serialized elements to the clipboard.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata including features, requirements, and current project state version.
